subject: general
question: Which of the following organisations deals with formulation and implementation of global trade?
solution:
Correct answer is __**WTO.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The World Trade Organization (WTO)** is an international organization of 164 members that **manage the rules of trade between nations.**
 
• The WTO has **over 160 members representing 98 per cent of world trade**. 
 
• WTO cheif work is **to ensure that trade flows as smoothly, predictably and freely as possible**.
 
• The World Trade Organisation was **started on January 1, 1995**, with the Marrakesh Agreement, which put back the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea920ab9b56302c17e60da3dea806546149db49c43896f2f705cd1c2ce899015.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The **International Monetary Fund** (IMF) works to achieve sustainable growth and prosperity for all of its 190 member countries. 
 
• **The World Health Organization is** an international organization that is a member of the United Nations and helps developing countries by giving them **information and medicine.**** **
 
• India is a originater member of the **International Labour Organization**, which came alive in 1919.
